Rows in the orders table now have 6px of padding above and below the text instead of 12px. The heading row is unchanged. The functional tests pass (16/16). I didn't open the page in a browser, so the new spacing hasn't been checked visually.

The rule is at the end of `site/css/pages.css`. It applies only to body cells on the orders page (`.page-orders .table tbody td`). The pricing page uses the same table styles, so I didn't change the shared rule in `components.css`, and pricing is unaffected.
